acts.palette: soot black, iron gray, copper, warm cream, electric blue, swarm teal
acts.map: Tall vertical top-down papercraft diorama of a power workshop, read bottom to top: enter past stone walls and shuttered windows, climb by a blue-water bucket wheel and narrow walkway, pass a stalled lift and paired generators, and arrive at an elevated generator platform where the Load Collector waits. Arrange flywheels, copper lamps, cell cabinets and loose cables around the margins; leave the middle ground open for readable path lines. Layered construction paper with visible grain, flat colors, crisp hand-cut edges, brass pins at joints and shadow-theatre lighting; no logos, readable text or people.
backdrops: Wide low-contrast fight background for floors 1–5: a dim stone generator room with shuttered windows, quiet copper lamps and a large iron flywheel at the far edge. A few small teal hexagonal paper patches creep along one floor seam. Open, uncluttered center for small creatures. Layered grainy construction paper, flat muted colors, crisp cut edges, brass pins on joints and soft shadow-theatre light; no central subject, logos, readable text or people.

Wide low-contrast fight background for floors 6–10: the same power workshop deeper inside, with a stalled lift, gray generator housings and copper cables receding along the sides. Teal hexagonal paper growth spreads in connected clusters over cable channels and lower walls, while the center remains open for small creatures. Layered grainy construction paper, flat muted colors, crisp cut edges, brass pins on joints and soft shadow-theatre light; no central subject, logos, readable text or people.

Wide low-contrast fight background for floors 11–15: the generator hall nearly swallowed by overlapping teal hexagonal paper growth that climbs the walls and wraps idle machinery, with only fragments of copper cable and iron wheels visible at the edges. Keep the broad middle ground quiet and open for small creatures. Layered grainy construction paper, flat muted colors, crisp cut edges, brass pins on joints and soft shadow-theatre light; no central subject, logos, readable text or people.
acts.boss: Full-body portrait of the Load Collector, a massive cylindrical generator on widely planted iron legs, wrapped in looping copper cables. A broad round shield made of cream ceramic insulator discs juts from one side; a bright blue meter sits at its heart. Give the machine a heavy, unmistakable silhouette with all feet and shield visible, against a simple dark power-hall background. Layered construction paper with visible grain, flat color, crisp hand-cut edges, brass pins at every joint and dramatic shadow-theatre light; no logos, readable text or people.

acts.palette: walnut brown, parchment cream, glass blue, copper, circuit yellow, swarm teal
acts.map: Tall vertical top-down papercraft diorama of an electrical demonstration museum, read bottom to top: enter through a narrow doorway beside a candle projector, move past an open crate of colored circuit blocks and a crystal receiver, then through a curtain-lined demonstration stage with bent blue tubes and a film reel. At the top, a raised workbench platform is the clear waiting place for the Curiosity Engine. Place exhibits around the edges and leave the middle ground open for path lines. Layered construction paper with visible grain, flat colors, crisp hand-cut edges, brass pins at joints and shadow-theatre lighting; no logos, readable text or people.
backdrops: Wide low-contrast fight background for floors 1–5: a quiet demonstration gallery with parchment plaster walls, a narrow doorway, a candle projector and a few walnut display cabinets along the edges. Tiny teal hexagonal paper patches appear at the skirting. Keep the center open for small creatures. Layered grainy construction paper, flat muted colors, crisp cut edges, brass pins on joints and soft shadow-theatre light; no central subject, logos, readable text or people.

Wide low-contrast fight background for floors 6–10: a deeper gallery with folded canvas curtains, blue bent tubes and copper leads along the side walls. Connected teal hexagonal paper growth spreads across the floor edges and climbs around the exhibits; preserve an open, quiet center for small creatures. Layered grainy construction paper, flat muted colors, crisp cut edges, brass pins on joints and soft shadow-theatre light; no central subject, logos, readable text or people.

Wide low-contrast fight background for floors 11–15: the demonstration stage heavily consumed by overlapping teal hexagonal paper growth, obscuring much of the curtains, tube displays and yellow circuit panels at the margins. Leave a broad low-detail middle ground for small creatures. Layered grainy construction paper, flat muted colors, crisp cut edges, brass pins on joints and soft shadow-theatre light; no central subject, logos, readable text or people.
acts.boss: Full-body composition of the Curiosity Engine: a towering walnut workbench standing on long splayed metal limbs, its tabletop packed with glass receivers and tangled copper leads. A broad shield assembled from yellow circuit boards gives one side a jagged silhouette; show every limb and the full shield against a simple gallery background. Layered construction paper with visible grain, flat color, crisp hand-cut edges, brass pins at every joint and dramatic shadow-theatre light; no logos, readable text or people.

acts.palette: archive tan, ivory white, slate gray, oxidized copper, deep navy, swarm teal
acts.map: Tall vertical top-down papercraft diorama of a museum archive and experiment halls, read bottom to top: enter past a rail, small bicycle and steam-engine shapes; pass beneath a pale glider and through aisles of tan archive boxes and wooden shelves; continue by a gray horn antenna and reflector to the final experiment chamber. At the top, a clear circular dais holds the Grand Demonstrator and its caged receiver. Arrange artifacts along the sides with open middle ground for path lines. Layered construction paper with visible grain, flat colors, crisp hand-cut edges, brass pins at joints and shadow-theatre lighting; no logos, readable text or people.
backdrops: Wide low-contrast fight background for floors 1–5: a calm collection hall with a pale glider overhead, a small bicycle and a fragment of rail along the sides, rendered in subdued ivory and slate. A few teal hexagonal paper patches gather at the floor edge. Keep the center open for small creatures. Layered grainy construction paper, flat muted colors, crisp cut edges, brass pins on joints and soft shadow-theatre light; no central subject, logos, readable text or people.

Wide low-contrast fight background for floors 6–10: archive shelving and tan boxes line the walls, with a trolley and black cords tucked to the sides. Teal hexagonal paper growth joins into broad bands over shelves and floor seams, leaving the middle ground open for small creatures. Layered grainy construction paper, flat muted colors, crisp cut edges, brass pins on joints and soft shadow-theatre light; no central subject, logos, readable text or people.

Wide low-contrast fight background for floors 11–15: the final experiment hall almost engulfed by overlapping teal hexagonal paper growth, swallowing archive boxes and winding around a gray antenna and copper apparatus at the edges. Keep a broad, quiet center open for small creatures. Layered grainy construction paper, flat muted colors, crisp cut edges, brass pins on joints and soft shadow-theatre light; no central subject, logos, readable text or people.
acts.boss: Full-body composition of the Grand Demonstrator, a towering assembly of massive iron wheels, clustered glass vessels and long sweeping copper arms. At its center a white receiver sits clearly visible inside a dark cage, framed by armored plates. Show the whole machine from its grounded wheels to its highest vessel, with a broad, imposing silhouette against a simple archive-hall background. Layered construction paper with visible grain, flat color, crisp hand-cut edges, brass pins at every joint and dramatic shadow-theatre light; no logos, readable text or people.
